theme_strategy.description: Tactical/Swiss Aviation Interface. High contrast, dark mode default for hangars and shop floors, reducing eye strain. Functional, flat surfaces with stark borders. Precision over softness.
theme_strategy.archetype: The Performance Pro / Swiss Brutalist Hybrid

rules: NEVER use Inter, Roboto, or Open Sans for headings.
Use IBM Plex Mono for all ATA citations, serial numbers, part numbers, and logbook entries.
Labels and overlines MUST be uppercase with wide tracking (tracking-[0.2em]).
Heading hierarchy gap must not exceed 2 Tailwind steps.

primary.description: Aviation Blue for primary actions and trusted pathways.

accent.description: Signal Orange for warnings, mechanical alerts, and decision points.

rules: No full-screen gradients. Use matte colors and solid backgrounds.
Never use pure black or pure white without intention. The background is tinted very slightly.
Interactive elements must have at least a 4.5:1 contrast ratio against their background.

structure: Left: Collapsible sleek Sidebar for Logbook, History, and Manuals.
Center: Primary Troubleshooting Chat Interface. Mechanic-first text responses with sequential steps.
Right: Dynamic Workbench/Reference Panel for displaying ATA manual excerpts, PDF views, and citations.
spacing: Use massive spacing (p-8 to p-12) around major containers.
Tight, dense spacing (gap-2, p-3) inside data tables and logbook entries.
Never center-align dense text or mechanical steps. Always left-align.
layouts.grid_bento: Use Mode B (High Density) for the Aircraft Profile Dashboard and Logbook statistics. 1px borders (border-border), no rounded corners, no soft shadows.

surfaces: Use 'Grid Borders' (The Technical Look) for the main layout divisions.
Use 'Solid Flat' surfaces for chat bubbles and reference cards. NO Glassmorphism (it reduces data legibility).
borders_and_radius: Global radius is 0px (Sharp). Use rounded-none everywhere.

chat_message.style: Flat box, left aligned, subtle left border for AI responses (border-l-4 border-l-primary).
chat_message.content: Mechanic-first structure: One sentence likely cause -> numbered steps -> decision points.

ata_citation.style: Inline tag, font-mono, bg-white/5 border border-white/20 px-2 py-0.5 text-xs text-blue-400 hover:bg-white/10 transition-colors cursor-pointer.

aircraft_profile.style: Bento grid header, showing Make, Model, Year, S/N, Config in mono font with dense data spacing.

pdf_viewer.style: Embedded right-panel iframe/canvas with technical overlay.

rules: Hover states must visibly increase contrast (e.g., hover:bg-white/10).
List items (troubleshooting steps) should stagger in quickly.
All interactive elements MUST include data-testid.
Ensure strong focus states (e.g., focus:ring-2 focus:ring-accent).
Do not rely on color alone to indicate status. Use icons + text.

image_urls.description: Cessna aircraft in flight. Use as an understated, low-opacity (10-20%) background header in the Aircraft Profile section.

icons.instruction: Use Phosphor Icons (duotone or regular) for sharp, technical look.

instructions_to_main_agent: Update tailwind.config.js to set radius to 0, and use the custom color palette (background: #050505, border: #262626).
Implement a 3-pane layout (Sidebar | Chat | Workbench) similar to Claude's artifact UI.
Do not use generic Shadcn cards with rounded corners. Override all shadcn primitive radii to 'rounded-none' and use flat 1px borders.
Ensure all technical data (ATA codes, Part Numbers) uses the IBM Plex Mono font.
For the AI Chat, present the response structurally: Start with a bold heading for the most likely cause, followed by an ordered list for troubleshooting steps.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You MUST NOT apply universal transitions (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions to specific properties only.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Text alignment should prioritize reading flow (left-aligned).
DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Never use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💡) for icons. Use proper SVG icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations (hover states, focus rings).
All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.
